encoding: UTF-8 JSON; nonnegative field elements encoded as decimal strings; indices are zero-based

root.inputs/KEY/input.json: Immutable input identity and planted witness, if present
root.protocol-prime-linear.json: Frozen protocol with all42 input and point-base identities
root.results/template-mM.json: Seven shared projected degree-five coefficient-map certificates
root.results/KEY.json: Source validation, nonzero weight inverses, six covering subsets and conditional FFD lower bound
root.manifest.sha256: SHA256 of every other raw payload

template.variables: ell_projected=5 selectors per block in block-major order, then m-2 unrestricted U variables; selector indices less than5*m
template.monomial: Sorted list of five variable indices, repeated U indices permitted; selector repetition reduced to zero
template.pivot_rows: Each stores original sparse coefficient row as [column, decimal coefficient] pairs, its degree-five monomial, pivot column and pre-normalization nonzero pivot
template.rank: Number of retained independent rows, <=columns; injective iff equal
template.reconstruction: Regenerate all quartics and variable multiples from PRIME_LINEAR_DESIGN.md, then deterministic sparse Gaussian elimination in lexicographic monomial order
template.limitation: A deficient projected rank is inconclusive for original27-selector systems; no original kernel is inferred

case.first_fall_lower_bound: 6 only if full source, normalization, projected injection and complete coverage verify; otherwise null
case.last_fall_lower_bound: always null; no new LFD claim

replay: instrument replay INPUT_ROOT PROTOCOL RESULTS recomputes source checks, field certificate, all seven full coefficient maps and pivot certificates; writes no results
